name: @activepieces/piece-folk
description: Folk is a CRM for building relationships at scale. Manage your contacts, companies, and relationships in one place.

auth.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

createCompany.name: createCompany
createCompany.description: Create a new company in your Folk workspace. You can add emails, links, phone numbers, and assign it to a group.

description.description: A short description of the company

industry.description: The industry the company operates in

addresses.description: Physical addresses for the company. The first address is primary.

emails.description: Email addresses for the company. The first email is primary.

phones.description: Phone numbers for the company. The first phone is primary.

urls.description: Website URLs for the company. The first URL is primary.

groupId.description: Enter a Folk group ID (e.g., grp_abc123). Groups help you organize your contacts.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new company record in the Folk CRM, optionally attaching addresses, emails, phone numbers, URLs, an industry, and a group assignment. Use when a company does not yet exist in Folk; only the company name is required. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate company even with identical input, so guard against duplicates (e.g. search with Find Company first).

updateCompany.name: updateCompany
updateCompany.description: Update an existing company in your Folk workspace. Select the company from the dropdown to update its details.

auth.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

companyId.description: Select a company from your Folk workspace.

description.description: A short description of the company

industry.description: The industry the company operates in

addresses.description: Physical addresses for the company. The first address is primary.

emails.description: Email addresses for the company. The first email is primary.

phones.description: Phone numbers for the company. The first phone is primary.

urls.description: Website URLs for the company. The first URL is primary.

auth.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

groupId.description: Enter a Folk group ID (e.g., grp_abc123). Groups help you organize your contacts.

aiMetadata.description: Updates fields on an existing Folk company identified by its company ID; only the fields you supply are changed. Use when you already know the target company ID (look it up first with Find Company or Get Company). Not idempotent in general: re-running mutates the record on each call and supplied arrays such as emails or groups replace prior values, so resubmitting the same input is not guaranteed to be a no-op.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new person (contact) record in the Folk CRM, optionally linking them to companies by ID or name, setting a job title and birthday, and adding emails, phones, addresses, URLs, and a group. Use to add a new contact when none exists; provide a name via first/last or full name. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate person, so check for existing contacts first to avoid duplicates.

aiMetadata.description: Updates fields on an existing Folk person identified by their person ID; only the fields you supply are changed, and supplied company names that do not yet exist are created. Use when you already know the target person ID (look it up first with List People or Get Person). Not idempotent in general: re-running mutates the record each call and supplied arrays replace prior values, so resubmitting the same input is not guaranteed to be a no-op.

findCompany.name: findCompany
findCompany.description: Search for companies in your Folk workspace by name or email address.

query.description: Enter company name or email to search for

aiMetadata.description: Searches the Folk CRM for companies matching a query string against company name or email, returning the matching companies. Use to resolve a company name or email into a company ID before updating or linking it. The search query is required. Read-only and idempotent: repeating the same query returns the same matches without side effects.

getCompany.name: getCompany
getCompany.description: Retrieve detailed information about a company from your Folk workspace.

auth.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

companyId.description: Select a company from your Folk workspace.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full record of a single Folk company by its company ID. Use when you already have the company ID and need its current details; if you only have a name or email, find the ID first with Find Company. Read-only and idempotent.

findPerson.name: findPerson
findPerson.description: Retrieve a paginated list of people in your Folk workspace with optional filtering.

limit.description: The number of items to return (1-100)

cursor.description: A cursor for pagination. Use the nextLink value from a previous response.

combinator.description: The logical operator to combine multiple filters

aiMetadata.description: Lists people (contacts) in the Folk CRM, returning a single cursor-paginated page. With no filters it returns all people; optional name and email filters (contains-match) combined by AND or OR narrow the results. Use to browse contacts or resolve a name/email into a person ID; pass the cursor to page through additional results. Read-only and idempotent.

getPerson.name: getPerson
getPerson.description: Retrieve detailed information about a person from your Folk workspace.

auth.description: Your Folk API key. You can view and manage your API keys in your workspace settings under the "API" section at https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys

personId.description: Select a person from your Folk workspace.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full record of a single Folk person (contact) by their person ID. Use when you already have the person ID and need their current details; if you only have a name or email, find the ID first with List People. Read-only and idempotent.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new company is created in the connected Folk workspace, optionally scoped to a single group. The event payload carries the new company ID and a URL to fetch its full details.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a company is deleted from the connected Folk workspace, optionally scoped to a single group. The event payload carries the deleted company ID along with a snapshot of its name and emails.

ja.Folk is a CRM for building relationships: Folk は大規模な関係を構築するための CRM です。連絡先、会社、関係を一箇所で管理します。
ja.Your Folk API key. You can view and mana: Folk APIキー。ワークスペースの設定で、https://app.folk.app/apps/contacts/network/settings/api-keys の "API" セクションでAPIキーを表示および管理できます。
ja.Create a new company in your Folk worksp: Folk ワークスペースで新しい会社を作成します。メール、リンク、電話番号を追加し、グループに割り当てることができます。
ja.Update an existing company in your Folk: Folk ワークスペースの既存の会社を更新します。ドロップダウンから会社を選択して詳細を更新します。
ja.Create a new person in your Folk workspa: Folk ワークスペースで新しい人を作成します。それらを会社にリンクし、連絡先の詳細を追加し、グループに割り当てることができます。
ja.Update an existing person in your Folk w: 新しい情報を使用して Folk ワークスペースの既存のユーザーを更新します。
ja.Search for companies in your Folk worksp: Folk ワークスペースの会社を名前またはメールアドレスで検索します。
ja.Retrieve detailed information about a co: Folk ワークスペースから会社の詳細情報を取得します。
ja.Retrieve a paginated list of people in y: オプションのフィルタリングを使用して format@@0 ワークスペースにいる人物のページ付けリストを取得します。
ja.Retrieve detailed information about a pe: フォークワークスペースから人に関する詳細情報を取得します。
ja.Filter Combinator: 組み合わせをフィルターする
ja.Physical addresses for the company. The: 会社の住所。最初の住所はプライマリです。
ja.Email addresses for the company. The fir: 会社のメールアドレス。最初のメールはプライマリです。
ja.Phone numbers for the company. The first: 会社の電話番号。最初の電話番号は主要です。
ja.Website URLs for the company. The first: 会社のウェブサイトURL。最初のURLはプライマリです。
ja.Enter a Folk group ID (e.g., grp_abc123): フォークグループIDを入力してください（例：grp_abc123）。グループは連絡先を整理するのに役立ちます。
ja.Select a company from your Folk workspac: Folk ワークスペースから会社を選択します。
ja.The full name of the person (alternative: 人のフルネーム (first/lastに代わる)
ja.The names of companies to associate with: 個人に関連付ける企業の名前。最初の会社が主要になります。
ja.Select companies to associate with the p: 個人に関連付ける会社を選択します。
ja.Physical addresses for the person. The f: その人のための物理的な住所。最初の住所はプライマリです。
ja.Email addresses for the person. The firs: ユーザーのメールアドレス。最初のメールはプライマリです。
ja.Phone numbers for the person. The first: 人物の電話番号。最初の電話番号は主要です。
ja.Website URLs for the person. The first U: ユーザのウェブサイトURL。最初のURLはプライマリです。
ja.Select a person from your Folk workspace: Folk ワークスペースから人を選択します。
ja.Company names to create or associate wit: 作成または関連付ける会社名。存在しない場合、会社は作成されます。
ja.Enter company name or email to search fo: 検索する会社名またはメールアドレスを入力してください
ja.The number of items to return (1-100): The number of items to return (1-100)
ja.A cursor for pagination. Use the nextLin: ページネーションのカーソル。前のレスポンスの nextLink 値を使用します。
ja.The logical operator to combine multiple: 複数のフィルタを組み合わせる論理演算子
ja.Filter by person name (contains): 個人名でフィルター (含む)
